sections.heading: History
sections.text:
As a Seeker, Casterwill's elder daughter served as the first Lady of the Lake and forged the powerful Willblade. She and her siblings helped Lord Casterwill fight the Nullifiers. [Knight of the Willblade]

She was the first to be bonded with Quetzalcoatl, whose Ring she placed within the Willblade. She later delivered the Willblade to her father so that he could seal the Spiral Mark with the sword. [The Spiral Mark]

On the longest night of the year, she and her siblings fought the Betrayer at the Spiral Mark, stopping him reactivating the mark and using Void to call back the Nullifiers. [Chasing Void]

She eventually laid the Willblade to rest, sealed in a stone on Avalon, where it was found by Lok Lambert. [Knight of the Willblade] Her Titan, Quetzalcoatl, was sealed in the Pyramid of the Sun, and used as a signal to call together the scattered Casterwill family many years later. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun] It was eventually recovered by Lok Lambert and returned to its original place in the Willblade. [Dante's Return]

full_text:
The elder daughter of Casterwill was the first Lady of the Lake and previous owner of Quetzalcoatl, the Legendary Titan of Summons.

History

As a Seeker, Casterwill's elder daughter served as the first Lady of the Lake and forged the powerful Willblade. She and her siblings helped Lord Casterwill fight the Nullifiers. [Knight of the Willblade]

She was the first to be bonded with Quetzalcoatl, whose Ring she placed within the Willblade. She later delivered the Willblade to her father so that he could seal the Spiral Mark with the sword. [The Spiral Mark]

On the longest night of the year, she and her siblings fought the Betrayer at the Spiral Mark, stopping him reactivating the mark and using Void to call back the Nullifiers. [Chasing Void]

She eventually laid the Willblade to rest, sealed in a stone on Avalon, where it was found by Lok Lambert. [Knight of the Willblade] Her Titan, Quetzalcoatl, was sealed in the Pyramid of the Sun, and used as a signal to call together the scattered Casterwill family many years later. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun] It was eventually recovered by Lok Lambert and returned to its original place in the Willblade. [Dante's Return]

Abilities

Casterwill's elder daughter was an extremely powerful Seeker, forging and wielding the mighty Willblade in battle.
